svg.title: Grouped and interleaved transformer winding fields

path.aria-label: Winding arrangement changes the field inside the copper
One series turn per radial layer; P and S carry opposing load ampere-turns
Grouped: P P P P S S S S
Interleaved: P S P S P S P S

g.aria-label: K = I / b; at a 50 A reference and b = 20 mm, K = 2500 A/m

path.aria-label: Lines connect boundary values; the actual high-frequency field within each foil follows diffusion.
Representative strands shown; insulation and bundle fields require further design.
